comparison.objective: Tighten a busbar lug bolt with a preset click wrench and stop at its one-shot click without overtorque. Candidate unlocks, tunes, and relocks a damper based on repeated impact response.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires a steady wrench pull and rapid cessation at detent break-over; the wrench and socket start installed. Candidate additionally requires recessed-key alignment, bimanual counterholding, unlocking, fine collar adjustment, relocking, and multiple evaluate-adjust cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a click and peak torque within 90–110% of 3 N·m, no reversal or overtorque, hands clear, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires retained adjustment plus two safe impacts within energy, speed, and stroke constraints.
comparison.reason: This is the closest force-tool record, but it tests one-shot torque-cue response on a prepositioned wrench, not tool insertion, unlock-adjust-lock sequencing, or commissioning from dynamic carriage behavior. Candidate still needs numeric rebound, overload, collar-drift tolerance, and witness-torque limits.
